summary_table: PDF57 compresses the sequence into tightening all main head bolts at 40 Nm, removing them, retightening at 23 Nm and performing 90-degree and 60-degree passes.
dedicated_procedure: PDF209–210 gives the detailed illustrated sequence: initial 40 Nm tightening, then removal/reinstallation and 23 Nm plus 90 degrees for each bolt in the specified order, followed by the collective 60-degree pass.
interpretation: The authored guide follows the detailed dedicated installation procedure and its illustrations, rather than expanding the summary table into a competing operation order. The numerical loads, angle totals and molybdenum-disulfide preparation agree. This note preserves the compressed summary wording and does not claim an OEM erratum was obtained.
